rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for shutting someone or something out or refusing to accept it.

example.english: The company's exclusion of the new colleague made them feel awful.
example.traditional: 公司對新同事嘅排斥，令佢好難受。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 deoi3 san1 tung4 si6 ge3 paai4 cik1 ling6 keoi5 hou2 naan4 sau6

rows.note: Use this when the exclusion means removing an option, person, or matter from consideration.

example.english: The exclusion of this option was a wise decision because it was too expensive.
example.traditional: 排除呢個方案係明智嘅決定，因為成本太高。
example.jyutping: paai4 ceoi4 ne1 go3 fong1 on3 hai6 ming4 zi3 ge3 kyut3 ding6 jan1 wai6 sing4 bun2 taai3 gou1

rows.traditional: 唔畀 A 參加 B
rows.jyutping: m4 bei2 A caam1 gaa1 B
rows.note: Use this everyday construction when the exclusion specifically means not allowing A to take part in B.

example.english: The organizers' exclusion of people under eighteen from this competition caused a lot of controversy.
example.traditional: 主辦方唔畀未夠十八歲嘅人參加呢個比賽，引起好大爭議。
example.jyutping: zyu2 baan6 fong1 m4 bei2 mei6 gau3 sap6 baat3 seoi3 ge3 jan4 caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 jan5 hei2 hou2 daai6 zang1 ji5
